notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness and that can tap to produce at least {U}.
description:
Activate the mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Retraction Helix by paying {U}, targeting the mana-producing creature.
Cast Sewer-veillance Cam by paying {U}.
When Sewer-veillance Cam enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Retraction Helix.
Activate the creature targeted by Retraction Helix by tapping it, returning Sewer-veillance Cam from the battlefield to your hand.
When Sewer-veillance Cam leaves the battlefield, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Retraction Helix.
Activate the mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Repeat from step 3.
